translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, abiro luongi nyaka karangʼo mondo ikonya
to ok iwinji?
Koso nyaka karangʼo maywakni kawacho,
“Timbe maricho omedore!”
To kata kamano ok ires ji?
En angʼo momiyo iweya mondo ane timbe maricho?
Koso en angʼo momiyo idhil gi timbe maricho?
Kethruok kod timbe maricho ochoma pile;
lwenje mangʼeny nitie kendo sigu medore.
Kuom mano chik ok nyal tiyo,
kendo adiera ok nenre.
Joma richo olworo joma kare,
kuom mano adiera ok nyal betie.
“Rang kendo inon ogendini mag piny
mondo ibed gi bwok maduongʼ.
Nimar abiro timo gimoro e ndalou
ma ok ubi yiego,
kata ka owachni.
Atingʼo jo-Babulon malo,
en oganda maonge gi ngʼwono kendo mager,
gin oganda mayweyo piny duto
kendo gikawo kuonde dak ma ok mekgi.
Gin joma ji oluoro kendo magoyo ji gi kihondko,
giloso chikegi giwegi,
kendo gichuno luor mag-gi giwegi.
Faresegi ringo mapiyo moloyo kwach,
kendo giger moloyo guo sudhe e sa ma piny imoree.
Faresegi mag lweny lengʼore ka gitingʼo wiyegi malo;
joidh faresegi aa kuma bor.
Gihuyo ka achuth madwaro kawo chiemo,
giduto gibiro monjou ne lweny.
Jolwenjgi dhi nyime mana ka yamb piny motwo
kendo gichoko joma otwe ka kwoyo.
Ginyiero ruodhi
kendo gijaro jotelo.
Ginyiero mier mochiel gi ohinga motegno;
gigero pidhe mag lowo ma giidhogo ohinga kendo gimako mier mochiel motegno.
Gikadho ka yamo,
ka gidhi kamoro machielo.
To kata kamano gin joketho,
nikech gikwano tekregi giwegi ka nyasachgi.”
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, donge in ema nyaka nene?
Yaye, Nyasacha, Nyasaye Maler, ok wanatho.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, iseyierogi mondo gibednwa jongʼad bura.
Yaye Nyasaye ma Lwanda, isewalogi mondo gikel kum.
Wengeni ler ma ok nyal ngʼiyo richo,
ok inyal bedo mamor gi gima rach.
To en angʼo momiyo koro ibedo mamor gi jo-andhoga?
Angʼo momiyo ilingʼ alingʼa ka jomaricho,
tieko joma kare moloyogi?
Isemiyo dhano obedo machalo gi rech manie nam,
mana kaka gik mochwe modak e nam maonge jatendgi.
Jaricho ywayogi ka makogi gi olowu,
kendo omakogi gi gogo,
kochokogi gi obadho mochiko,
kendo obedo mamor kuom lupo.
Emomiyo, ochiwo misango kuom gogo mar lupo
kendo owangʼo ubani ne obadho mar chiko rech,
nikech gogo mare miyo odak e ngima maber
kendo ochamo chiemo moyier maber.
Bende ber mondo odhi nyime kogolo gik momako e gogo mare,
kotieko ogendini ka oonge ngʼwono?
